text:
The plate holds a stir-fry of chicken, green beans, red peppers and carrots over rice, in a sauce. A separate bowl holds fruit (apple, strawberry, blueberry, maybe grape). The water has no calories.

Stir-fry on a paper plate: about 250 g, including roughly 80 g rice, 80 g chicken, 70 g vegetables and some sauce. At about 1.4 kcal/g that is roughly 350 kcal.

Fruit bowl: about 80 g at 0.55 kcal/g, roughly 45 kcal.

Total: about 330 g and about 395 kcal. I'm treating "everything on the plate" as the stir-fry plus the fruit bowl.

{"kcal": 395, "mass_g": 330}
